account:
Today has appeared routine so far. I have a feeling something may be happening without my knowledge, but I have found no concrete evidence of unusual activity. During my morning market walk, Townsfolk 10, 20, and 30 said they had no news. Townsfolk 08 and 28 reported seeing the baker carrying wheat at the bakery. That seems consistent with bread-making; nobody has described anything suspicious about it. The secretary likewise said nothing unusual was reported and no repair requests had come from these residents.

The builder wants this week's repair priorities and an agreed payment recorded before starting. I requested an inspection of the bridge and public lighting, with specific defects and an estimate before any repairs. No paid work or inspection fee has been authorized. The secretary is keeping the record, and the builder's estimate is expected at my thirteen o'clock accounts appointment. This appears to be ordinary town maintenance business, not evidence of a hidden undertaking.

I returned home for my scheduled noon lunch and am here at 12:33. Next I should return to the office for accounts at 13:00. Later appointments are tea at the dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I will keep asking discreetly about town affairs, distinguishing actual observations from my suspicion that I am missing something.
